species.name: Striped bass
why: Water 64°F on top, a bit cool for them, so they feed in the warmest water they can find.
Best water today is 8–22 ft deep, mostly on open water over the deep basin.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 65 ft, cold below.
Little oxygen below about 95 ft, so fish stay above it.
